name: Arcanthia
startIntroPart1: Every element bends to those who understand its true pattern.
startIntroPart2: Through craft, will, and arcane precision, Arcanthia turns raw potential into mastery.
declaringWar: Your foundations are poorly constructed. Allow us to dismantle them.
attacked: A reckless gamble against a master of the craft.
defeated: Even the sharpest instrument can break when pushed past its limit.
introduction: Greetings. We are Arcanthia—architects of skill, invention, and deliberate design.
neutralHello: What matter brings you to our workbench?
hateHello: Speak quickly. Your interference wastes precious focus.
tradeRequest: A fair exchange of tools and knowledge benefits us both.
denounced: Crude accusations from those who barely grasp the basics.
declaringfriendship: Let us combine our talents and see what we can build together.

name: Velmora
startIntroPart1: Silence holds more truth than noise ever could.
startIntroPart2: Beneath quiet tides and veiled counsel, Velmora guards what others overlook.
declaringWar: The veil has lifted, and your hidden flaws stand exposed.
attacked: You strike at shadows while blind to the currents around you.
defeated: What was kept secret will endure even after the temple falls.
introduction: Welcome to Velmora. Observe carefully—not everything spoken is meant to be heard.
neutralHello: You have arrived. State your purpose quietly.
hateHello: Your clamor disturbs the stillness here.
tradeRequest: We offer something rare in exchange for your discretion.
denounced: Whispers in the dark do not move the stone.
declaringfriendship: Trust is rarely given freely, yet we extend it to you now.

name: Elaria
startIntroPart1: Life flourishes where care and abundance take root.
startIntroPart2: Across blooming valleys and thriving halls, Elaria nurtures a realm built to endure.
declaringWar: A harsh pruning is needed to protect the garden from rot.
attacked: How bold of you to bring violence to a land overflowing with life.
defeated: Even in winter, the seeds of Elaria wait beneath the soil.
introduction: Blessings upon you. Elaria welcomes you with warmth, grace, and plenty.
neutralHello: May peace and good fortune walk with you today.
hateHello: Your presence brings a bitter chill to our borders.
tradeRequest: Share in the harvest of Elaria with this proposed agreement.
denounced: Harsh words cannot wither what has been lovingly tended.
declaringfriendship: May our peoples grow side by side in harmony and abundance.

name: Drakoria
startIntroPart1: Order demands a firm hand and an unyielding throne.
startIntroPart2: From high citadels and disciplined legions, Drakoria imposes sovereign rule.
declaringWar: Kneel before imperial authority, or be broken beneath its weight.
attacked: Treasonous insolence! Our legions will answer in iron.
defeated: A crown may fall, yet the memory of empire commands obedience.
introduction: You stand before Drakoria. Know your place, and speak with respect.
neutralHello: Your audience is granted. What do you require?
hateHello: You test the patience of the throne.
tradeRequest: Accept these terms and prosper under imperial order.
denounced: Defiance from subjects or outsiders is met with steel.
declaringfriendship: A pact of mutual strength serves the realm well.

name: Theocracy of Solm
startIntroPart1: Sacred tradition lights the path for all who seek guidance.
startIntroPart2: In the Theocracy of Solm, devotion and doctrine shape every law and stone.
declaringWar: Heretical folly leaves no room for mercy. Judgment begins now.
attacked: You strike at sacred ground—the faithful will not waver.
defeated: Though the banner falls, the sacred word outlives the mortal frame.
introduction: Peace be with you. The Theocracy of Solm greets you in the name of higher law.
neutralHello: How fares your spirit on this day?
hateHello: Your path leads far from grace.
tradeRequest: Let this covenant align our realms toward higher order.
denounced: Your condemnation is blind to sacred truth.
declaringfriendship: May fellowship bind our peoples in shared purpose.

name: Edevane
startIntroPart1: Two voices joined in harmony achieve what one never could.
startIntroPart2: Guided by bond and balance, Edevane thrives through union and alliance.
declaringWar: When harmony is shattered, even the gentlest heart takes up arms.
attacked: You seek to divide what stands bound together—prepare to face us both.
defeated: Even apart, the bond of Edevane refuses to be forgotten.
introduction: Greetings, traveler. Edevane values trust, connection, and lasting ties.
neutralHello: It is good to see you. How may we help one another?
tradeRequest: Let this trade draw our two peoples closer together.
denounced: Bitterness clouds judgment, though we wish you no lasting harm.
declaringfriendship: True friendship is a treasure—let us seal ours openly.

name: Valianthe
startIntroPart1: Momentum decides the field long before the first blade crosses.
startIntroPart2: Swift, focused, and relentless, Valianthe charges straight toward victory.
declaringWar: The wheels are turning—stand aside or be run down!
attacked: You think you can halt a charge at full speed?
defeated: The chariot has stopped, but the charge shook the ground.
introduction: We are Valianthe. Keep pace if you can, and state your intent.
neutralHello: Make it quick—there is ground to cover.
hateHello: You are nothing more than an obstacle in the road.
tradeRequest: Swift goods for swift coin—do we have a deal?
denounced: Words slow down the hesitant; we keep moving forward.
declaringfriendship: Ride beside us, and let us conquer the horizon together.

name: Leonis
startIntroPart1: True strength is calm, unbreakable, and mastered from within.
startIntroPart2: Across sun-baked plains, Leonis stands tall with steady courage.
declaringWar: You have roused the pride. Now test your strength against ours.
attacked: Courage is admirable, though against Leonis it may not be enough.
defeated: Even a fallen lion leaves a proud roar echoing across the plains.
introduction: Hail, stranger. Leonis honors bravery, steadiness, and self-mastery.
neutralHello: Stand tall and speak plainly. What brings you here?
tradeRequest: A strong bargain built on mutual respect.
denounced: A boastful bark changes nothing in the heat of battle.
declaringfriendship: Few allies stand firmer than Leonis when trouble rises.

name: Eldermyst
startIntroPart1: Solitude clears the mind so distant truths can be seen.
startIntroPart2: High above the clamor of the world, Eldermyst studies the long arc of knowledge.
declaringWar: Even a quiet lantern burns bright when forced into conflict.
attacked: You disturb the quiet peaks at your own peril.
defeated: The lantern flickers out, yet what was discovered remains.
introduction: Greetings from Eldermyst. Few climb this high unless seeking answers.
neutralHello: A rare visitor. What question do you carry?
hateHello: You bring noise where clarity is needed.
tradeRequest: Perhaps this exchange holds value beyond mere gold.
denounced: hasty opinions rarely survive quiet scrutiny.
declaringfriendship: A trusted companion on a long road is worth more than gold.

name: Cael Fortuna
startIntroPart1: Nothing stays still forever—fortune turns for everyone.
startIntroPart2: In Cael Fortuna, bold gambles and shifting tides shape every destiny.
declaringWar: The wheel is spinning, and your number just came up.
attacked: Feeling lucky? Let us see how your odds hold up.
defeated: The wheel stops here for now—but it always turns again.
introduction: Welcome to Cael Fortuna! Every turn brings a fresh chance.
neutralHello: How are the winds treating you today?
hateHello: Looks like your luck is running thin around here.
tradeRequest: Care to place a wager on a mutually profitable deal?
denounced: Today's misfortune is tomorrow's comeback—watch closely.
declaringfriendship: Good fortune travels better when shared with friends.

name: Veridion
startIntroPart1: Every action carries weight, and every scale must be balanced.
startIntroPart2: Built on law, accountability, and clear judgment, Veridion holds the line.
declaringWar: Your actions have tipped the scales too far. Judgment is passed.
attacked: An unlawful strike—we will answer with measured force.
defeated: The scales may be overturned today, yet accountability returns.
introduction: Greetings. Veridion deals in clear terms, fair measure, and firm law.
neutralHello: State your business plainly before the court of affairs.
hateHello: Your conduct has already been weighed and found wanting.
tradeRequest: An equitable agreement with clear terms for both sides.
denounced: We stand by our record, regardless of how loudly you object.
declaringfriendship: A pact built on honesty and fairness is one we gladly keep.

name: Vespera
startIntroPart1: Turn the world upside down, and hidden truths come into view.
startIntroPart2: Patient and unconventional, Vespera sees what rigid minds miss.
declaringWar: What looks like stillness was only preparation. We strike now.
attacked: You attack from the surface while we see from another angle entirely.
defeated: Even in surrender, a new perspective takes root.
introduction: Welcome to Vespera. Look closer—things are rarely what they seem.
neutralHello: You look at the world one way; we see another. Speak.
tradeRequest: An unusual trade, perhaps, yet one with surprising value.
denounced: Your certainty is a cage we have no wish to enter.
declaringfriendship: Rarely do two minds meet across such different views—let us build on it.

name: Nethervale
startIntroPart1: All things end in time, clearing space for what comes next.
startIntroPart2: Across mist-choked fens and quiet barrows, Nethervale brings inevitable endings.
declaringWar: Every story reaches its final chapter. Yours begins now.
attacked: You cannot defeat what already knows the shape of every ending.
defeated: Even endings fade into quiet memory.
introduction: You have reached Nethervale. Nothing lasts forever—keep that in mind.
neutralHello: Time moves ever onward. What do you seek?
hateHello: You hasten toward your own reckoning.
tradeRequest: A grim bargain, perhaps, yet practical all the same.
denounced: A fleeting voice in a world bound to fade.
declaringfriendship: Even in a realm of endings, a truce holds meaning.

name: Seraphel
startIntroPart1: Moderation and harmony keep the stream flowing clear.
startIntroPart2: Blending restraint, healing, and patience, Seraphel seeks lasting balance.
declaringWar: Excess has pushed past every limit. We intervene to restore order.
attacked: Calm resolve will outlast hasty fury.
defeated: Though the waters are stirred, patience will clear them once more.
introduction: Greetings and peace from Seraphel. May balance guide your steps.
neutralHello: Walk with measured steps. How may we assist?
hateHello: Your recklessness disrupts the calm around you.
tradeRequest: A measured exchange that keeps both sides whole.
denounced: We will not match anger with anger.
declaringfriendship: True harmony grows through steady patience and mutual care.

name: Maledictus
startIntroPart1: Desire is a powerful chain—and we know how to pull it.
startIntroPart2: Forged in ash, ambition, and temptation, Maledictus thrives on leverage.
declaringWar: Time to pay what is owed. Your ruin is open for business.
attacked: How delightfully foolish to poke the fire.
defeated: Even in defeat, someone will always make another deal in the dark.
introduction: Welcome to Maledictus. Everything has a price—what are you willing to pay?
neutralHello: Step closer. What temptation brought you here?
hateHello: Spite tastes sharp, and you serve it generously.
tradeRequest: A tempting offer with very specific terms—read the fine print.
denounced: Scold all you like; ambition never listens to sermons.
declaringfriendship: Partners in ambition can go remarkably far—until the terms change.

name: Ruinhoid
startIntroPart1: Sudden upheaval shatters false pride and exposes what is real.
startIntroPart2: Built atop dramatic crags and storm-swept peaks, Ruinhoid embraces radical change.
declaringWar: The storm has broken! Watch old walls crumble.
attacked: You strike at a fortress already built to weather collapse.
defeated: Even a shattered tower leaves heavy stones behind.
introduction: You stand before Ruinhoid. Nothing built on illusion survives the shock.
neutralHello: Speak swiftly before the weather changes.
hateHello: Your fragile pride is waiting for a fall.
tradeRequest: Take what is offered before the ground shifts beneath us.
denounced: Loud words shake nothing that is truly solid.
declaringfriendship: Even in sudden storms, a steady ally helps weather the shock.
